top.tagline: Book your table online in a couple of minutes.
top.pausedNotice: Online booking is temporarily unavailable. Please contact us directly to make a reservation.
top.closedNotice: We are not accepting online reservations right now. Please check back later.

date.heading: Choose a date & time
date.subheading: Availability shown is for the next three weeks.

plan.heading: Choose a plan
plan.slotFullError: The selected slot is now full. Please choose another time.

guestInfo.heading: Your details
guestInfo.demoHint: Demo tip: include "fail", "conflict", or "review" in the email to preview those outcomes at payment.

payment.heading: Payment
payment.disclaimer: Payment processing will be enabled in a future release. Confirming now will place your reservation without a charge.

confirmation.missingDetails: We couldn't find the details for this confirmation.
confirmation.confirmedBody: A confirmation email is on its way. You can view or change your reservation anytime using the link in that email.
confirmation.reviewBody: Your payment went through, but we need to double-check availability for this slot. The restaurant will confirm shortly.

manage.invalidTitle: This link is no longer valid
manage.invalidBody: The reservation link has expired or doesn't exist. Please contact the restaurant directly for help.
manage.supersededBody: This reservation was changed and replaced by a newer one.
manage.codeChangedBody: Your previous code {oldCode} is no longer valid — please use {newCode} going forward.
manage.deadlinePassedNote: The cancellation window for this reservation has passed. Please contact the restaurant directly.
manage.cancelConfirmBody: Are you sure you want to cancel this reservation? This can't be undone.
manage.changeReassurance: Your current reservation stays as-is unless this change can be confirmed.
